You Call Stephanie Morris for a 30-day status check on the quiet logistics buyer inquiry she initiated at tick 9. Ask directly: has she made contact with one or two qualified logistics/delivery operator buyers? Has anyone expressed interest in the $285K-$330K range or indicated they would pay a premium for the covered canopy and existing electrical infrastructure? I need to know whether this path is producing any signal before I hit the 60-day gate. If Stephanie has made contact but is waiting on responses, I extend the window. If she has had no traction with the buyer profile, I need to know that now — not at day 60 — so I can adjust my timeline. I also acknowledge her $1,500 valuation fee directly and commit to payment within 30 days.. Savings dropped by $3,533.
